reply: high T, and a non-monotonic dependence on strain (a drop at small ε, then a rise). A purely additive model in ε and T fits poorly, so ε and T interact. My final evaluated candidate, `a + b·T^c + (d + e·T)·exp(−f·ε) + g·ε + h·ε·T`, scored worse (NMSE 2.5×10⁻³), so the recorded best is the 7×10⁻⁴ one.

best.code:
def equation(eps, T, params):
    return params[0] + params[1]*np.exp(-params[2]*eps) + params[3]*eps + params[4]*np.exp(-params[5]*T) + params[6]*T + params[7]*eps*T
